description: Life does not get easier but we get smarter #fyp #lifebydesign #careeradvice #leadershipdevelopment
transcript: Life does not get easier. It actually gets a bit more challenging. The more that I walk in acceptance, the more that I take accountability, the more that I take control and ownership over my actions and my ideas and my thoughts, the harder it is for me to stay in a space of ignorance. I understand that things are harder because I'm more experienced, so I don't blindly walk through things and make excuses when I make decisions that are not the best decisions for those circumstances. So, although life does not get easier, I'm finding myself enjoying the experience more because I'm okay with what comes my way.
